# MENTOR

> > MENTOR works to close the mentoring gap by advancing policies, funding, and grassroots action to connect young people with mentors.

MENTOR is a national nonprofit organization focused on youth mentoring advocacy and policy change. The site features advocacy initiatives, resource libraries, campaigns like National Mentoring Month, and opportunities for supporters to donate and get involved in closing the mentoring gap.

## Key Topics

- Mentoring Gap
- Youth Advocacy
- Mentoring Policy
- Legislative Priorities
- Government Relations
- National Mentoring Month
- Advocacy Network
- Mentoring Programs
- Nonprofit Impact
- Voting Engagement
- Fundraising
- Excellence in Mentoring
- Movement Makers
- National Mentoring Summit
- Charity Rating

## Advocacy & Policy

- [MENTOR Advocacy](https://www.mentoring.org/advocacy): MENTOR advocacy hub for policies, funding, and legislative action on mentoring gap
- [National Mentoring Month](https://www.mentoring.org/campaigns/national-mentoring-month): National Mentoring Month campaign resources and involvement opportunities

## Resources & Learning

- [Resource Library](https://mentoring.org/resource-library): Comprehensive resource library with mentoring guides, webinars, and toolkits

## News & Stories

- [Blog](https://mentoring.org/blog): MENTOR blog featuring mentoring stories and youth advocacy insights
- [In the News](https://mentoring.org/in-the-news): MENTOR press releases and media coverage on mentoring programs

## Get Involved

- [Donate](https://mentoring.org/take-action/donate): Donation page for supporting MENTOR's youth mentoring mission
